description: Make one of your site's pages from AppPage.net's templates, the same ones as its privacy policy, terms, account deletion and support page generators: fixed, store-ready English text where each answer turns whole sections on or off. The app's name, developer, contact email (Google Play), website, platform, collected data types, ads, in-app purchases, version and the store's FAQ come from the store listing; your answers override them. Prefer this to writing a page yourself with set_page. Ask the user what the listing can't tell (SDKs, accounts, children, where they're based) before generating. save=false returns the page as Markdown without saving.

answers.description: Optional answers; anything left out comes from the store listing or a safe default. privacy_policy: developer, email, website, countryName (where the developer is based), data (list of: account, phone, location, contacts, photos, audio, files, calendar, health, payments, messages, content, device, usage, diagnostics), services (list of SDK keys: firebase_analytics, crashlytics, sentry, mixpanel, amplitude, appsflyer, adjust, admob, applovin, unity_ads, meta_an, ironsource, liftoff, firebase_auth, google_signin, apple_signin, facebook_login, firebase_db, supabase, fcm, onesignal, play_billing, apple_iap, revenuecat, stripe, google_maps), account, deletionUrl, kids (directed at children), gdpr, ccpa, kvkk, retention (needed, device or account). terms: developer, email, website, countryName, minAge (any, 13, 16 or 18), price (free or paid), iap, subs, trial, virtual (in-app currency), ads, account, ugc (users post content), social (users talk to each other), ai (AI features), health. delete_account: developer, email, inApp + steps (list of in-app steps), byEmail, web + webUrl, deleted (list of: account, profile, content, messages, activity, location, health, device), keepPurchases + purchaseYears, keepLegal, keepBackups + backupDays, keepShared, keepStats, days (to delete), partial, subs. support: developer, email, website, reply (24h, 2d or 3d), purchases, subs, account, bugs, ipad, version, whatsNew, custom (list of {q, a} FAQ entries). Yes/no answers are true or false.

save.description: true (default) saves and publishes the page; false only returns it for review.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: generate_page
title: Generate a site page
